description: Make a printable calendar PDF: a month grid (one page per month, several months in a row if you like) or a whole year on one page, A4 or Letter, landscape or portrait. Week starts on Saturday (default, like the website), Sunday or Monday; optional Hijri (Umm al-Qura) dates; events (one-off or yearly, 7 colours) shown in the day cells, or as coloured days plus a legend in the year view; optional title. English names by default; other Latin-script locales (fr, de, es, tr…) use their own month/day names. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/calendar-maker/

yearly.description: Repeats every year from that date on (birthdays, holidays).

locale.description: Language for month/day names (default en). Latin-script locales only.

months.description: Month view: how many consecutive months (one page each).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

title.description: Optional title above the month name, e.g. "Family calendar".

view.description: month = month grid pages, year = 12 months on one page.

weekStart.description: First day of the week: 6 = Saturday (default), 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday.

name: doc_calendar
title: Calendar PDF
